content: PRIMARY-VERIFIED (GitHub API + README release/v1): pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish v1.14.3 (2026-10-20). Use @release/v1 (master sunset) or SHA pin. Trusted publishing: permissions id-token: write (publish job only), environment pypi, NO token. Attestations ON by default (Sigstore, PEP 740, trusted-publishing PyPI/TestPyPI only); attestations:false disables. Build dists in separate low-privilege job (upload/download-artifact); docker-based Linux-only; NOT usable from reusable workflows; inputs repository-url/packages-dir/skip-existing/verify-metadata. Configure trusted publisher on PyPI for docsif (owner zhangtaolab/sif, workflow, environment).
